title: What the gallbladder does during digestion
intro: The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile made by the liver. It helps deliver bile when needed for digestion but is not the organ that makes it. Understanding that distinction helps explain life after gallbladder removal.

sections.heading: Storage
paragraphs: Between meals, bile can enter the gallbladder through its duct. Removing water concentrates it; bile contains salts and waste pigments as well as other substances.

sections.heading: Release with food
paragraphs: Signals after eating make the gallbladder contract. Bile passes through ducts into the small intestine, where bile salts help disperse fats for digestion and absorption.

sections.heading: Blockage
paragraphs: Stones may remain silent or obstruct a duct. Location matters: obstruction can cause pain, inflammation or jaundice. Upper abdominal pain alone cannot establish which organ is responsible.

sections.heading: After removal
paragraphs: The liver still makes bile, which reaches the bowel without gallbladder storage. Many people digest adequately; persistent diarrhea or pain should be reviewed, not assumed inevitable or treated with a lifelong extreme diet.

sections.heading: When to seek care
paragraphs: Severe or persistent upper abdominal pain needs assessment. Pain with fever, jaundice or repeated vomiting needs urgent care. Do not attempt a homemade gallbladder flush to remove suspected stones.

A diagram explains typical structure, not the cause of an individual symptom. Before a consultation, note when a change began, what brings it on and how it affects daily activities. Bring previous results and ask how the findings fit together.

examples.title: A practical example
examples.text: In this hypothetical example, Mira worries surgery will stop all bile production. She asks how liver bile reaches the intestine after removal.

examples.title: Another practical example
examples.text: In this hypothetical example, Arben has upper abdominal pain with fever and yellow eyes. He seeks urgent help instead of trying a cleansing drink.
